title: Roundup issues: weekly draft, admin approval for a time, idempotent batched send, web archive
description: Per-list schedule assembles a draft Item from the week's published items; admin approval creates a one-time EventBridge Scheduler send; start-send re-checks the content hash and postal address; SQS-paced worker with an at-most-once ledger per subscriber per issue and a stop flag; on completion the issue Item is published (archive page, Markus twin, llms.txt).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Built and merged to develop: PR #538 (feat: newsletter roundup issues, approval and paced sending). Draft assembly per ISO week, admin approval with one-time schedule and content hash, start-send guards (edited, postal address, paused), SQS worker with at-most-once ledger, SES List-Unsubscribe headers and tags, pacing, test send, eight AppSync operations (newsletterIssues, newsletterIssue, newsletterPreview, newsletterApproveIssue, newsletterCancelIssue, newsletterStopIssue, newsletterTestSend, newsletterCreateDraft). Core change: the standard projector now projects every Item type in listings.types, so issues archive from projection.json alone (docs/newsletter.md). Verification: CI green (python, ts, smoke); pytest 2231 passed locally (4 unrelated failures from this machine's CLI login); behave 375 scenarios passed including newsletter-roundup.feature; test:newsletter-plugin covers queue, DLQ, worker, schedules and IAM; full backend synth with the plugin succeeds. Not on develop->main. Live check pending: the plugin is not enabled on any site yet.
